title: locale.getdefaultlocale is deprecated
summary: Python 3.11 deprecates locale.getdefaultlocale(), to be removed in Python 3.15.

constraints: Keep the behavior of the call unchanged; check the replacement's argument and return-type differences.

steps.title: Use the locale API
steps.instructions: Use locale.getlocale() for the current locale and locale.getpreferredencoding(False) for the encoding.

verification.purpose: Run the tests with deprecation warnings as errors when pytest is used.
